description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) ADAPTIVE STRATEGY (Gladius Task Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the seven WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP.
